title: Formula One Race Car
description: A complete open-wheel race car built as one continuous parameter-curve loft from nose to engine cover, with a recess-opening cockpit section, superellipse sidepods carrying a real inlet aperture, spanwise airfoil wing lofts, a two-plane livery projector, a load-deflected tyre carcass, and per-part triangle evidence.
techniques: monotone parameter-curve tracks driving one continuous hull loft
semantic section control points with a cockpit recess parameter
superellipse sidepod sections with undercut and aero shelf
spanwise airfoil lofts with chord, incidence, camber and dihedral
authored outline plates with holes, bevels and 3D warps
measured tyre carcass with baked contact-patch deflection
generated carbon twill, sidewall and display textures
